name: monstera-adversarial-review
description: Attack a change (probes that try to break its guarantees) in parallel with an independent architecture review; merge into one issues-only report.

branches.prompt: Target: {{target}}. Guarantees to attack: {{guarantees}}. For each guarantee, write and run probes that try to violate it (malformed inputs, path tricks, overwrite and ownership attacks, schema evolution, cross-OS bytes, concurrency/interruption). Work only in a temporary directory outside the repository and do not modify tracked files. For each successful attack, write a failing regression test into .kiro/workflow-output/adversarial/tests.patch. Write .kiro/workflow-output/adversarial/attack.md: probe, expected, observed, verdict.
Review {{target}} against .kiro/steering/*.md and architecture/*.md. Report rule violations only (not style), each with location and evidence, to .kiro/workflow-output/adversarial/architecture.md.

steps.prompt: Merge .kiro/workflow-output/adversarial/attack.md and architecture.md into .kiro/workflow-output/adversarial/report.md. Issues only, ranked by impact, each with reproduction and the proposed regression test from tests.patch. End with BLOCKERS: <n>.
